notes.title: Hollow Mine v.0.8 Demo Is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello! The feedback from the February Steam Next Fest led to major changes and adjustments in version 0.8. Interacting with you on Discord, the Steam Community Hub, in reviews, and on other platforms gave me many insights that helped improve Hollow Mine. I want to keep the conversation going and would love to hear more of your suggestions.

If you would like to share your opinion, please join our Discord and share your ideas with me and the Hollow Mine community. This process keeps driving improvements for the game. It’s really satisfying to see how Hollow Mine has progressed so far, and to imagine what it could become in the future. It’s all possible because of the community we’re building together. Thank you!

What’s new? Version 0.8 makes the game much more readable, especially during heavy action and bullet hell fights. I wanted to reduce the number of steps needed for any task as much as possible. For example, when opening chests, you no longer need to click a button - just push it. Also, starting a conversation with an NPC that has only one menu option automatically skips the menu and goes straight to the dialogue. Or when using the Roll Item Box - just push it, no further action required. I believe these quality of life improvements will help players focus on the action and have a better overall experience.

The new room lighting system ties into these readability improvements, making it clearer where to direct your attention on the screen.

But improving readability and visibility is not all this update has to offer. The Mother of Bees is a new boss you can battle in the forest biome, featuring a new fighting style that surprises players and raises the challenge.

notes.title: What's coming? Exciting Changes in v.0.8 - Devlog
notes.content:
Hello! It's time to share what I was working on since the Steam Next Fest ended. Most of the changes are influenced by feedback i got from this event. I hope you are going to like it.

[h2]Upcoming Features and Changes:[/h2]

[b]NEW Main Menu Illustration[/b]
The Artist Jakub Tito Kašiar made new main menu illustration for Hollow Mine. No more boring menu! Thanks to new illustration, game feels much more atmospheric and climatic. It should bring more positive feelings for the players and send a message that Hollow Mine is a real deal. I hope you like it, let me know in the comments what you think about the new main menu illustration.

You can find Jakub Tito Kašiar here: [url=https://www.instagram.com/kasiarjakub/]https://www.instagram.com/kasiarjakub/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/5a1f58acf5a661f177786ecf9969b8b21541661b.png[/img]

[b]Improved Lighting[/b]
Since the beginning of times I heard feedback saying that "Why I am blocked to dig" and during intense action combat players would say "I don't see what is going on". I definitely agree with this comments. I decided to try to fix it by introducing new room lighting. 

After couple trials and errors I finally figured how to apply lighting to the rooms in the way that fits the game and it's not buggy. I managed to accomplish it! Now active area of the room is much brighter, beyond the room border - background is darker. It wasn't that hard as I thought it would be. 

With new lighting players will be able to see the walkable and destroyable area more easily. It should also help with intense combat action moments to focus the eyes on the area that is actually relevant the most. 

In forest biome the lighting gradient is less affecting the background, because it's outside area. Internal closed biomes, like mine biome, will have background blacked out. 

I hope you will like the new lighting for rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/9edf94fe5576d480ca6517b92301a2fcf80ea38d.png[/img]

[b]Bouncy Projectiles Ability[/b]
Do you experience issues with aiming straight on the enemies? Say nothing! Just try bouncy projectiles to increase your chance to hit anything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a5d7ee4c02cf3c0a1ce43f645499f714612bba0b.gif[/img]

[b]Greater Fireball Magic Spell[/b]
Do walls stand in your way to get to evil creatures? No longer! Use Greater Fireball spell with ability to break walls on impact. The projectiles are, so big they can also damage surrounding enemies in small range.

* - And yes it's possible to break ore veins with this spell ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/0c58fff7ffc857a7fc142af3fab1d1904b95e5c7.gif[/img]

[b]Making Game More Challenging[/b]
Hollow Mine is suppose to be a bullet hell game, unfortunately it's still not there yet. Enemies in the game needs a lot of adjustments. I introduced a set of changes and improvements to make it possible, see below:

[list]
[*] Enemy attack patterns will be more various now, leaving less reaction time and making them more challenging.
[*] Dash will make player evade enemy projectiles and enemy attacks now.
[*] Enemies will be lighter to push back when player is body blocked.
[*] Enemy animations will be adjusted to improve signaling attacks to the player more
[*] After receiving the hit, player short invincibility ghost will last less time now (1s -> 0.35s, 2s -> 0.7s - with Double Ghost Ability)
[/list]  
These changes are aimed to make the combat more challenging and dynamic. Player gained the possibility to dash through the bullets unharmed, in exchange for introducing more complex bullet patterns - similar to Enter the Gungeon game.

[b][i]If you are experienced bullet hell player with a lot of hours into games similar to Hollow Mine, please contact me on discord. I would love to chat and hear the feedback ;-)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/bc360f4a2a48d2e7eb8c2d21ca723df21048b58a.gif[/img]

[b]Forest Biome New Floor Tiles Colors[/b]
It was always a case where I couldn't figured out the proper colors for Hollow Mine. I am programmer first and art comes second. I'm actually learning pixel art while developing Hollow Mine. Throughout the years I improved in pixel art style. I recommend to watch the old devlogs or articles about the game to see the difference. I hope I improved at least - let me know in comments :-P

As I get more knowledge about pixel art and colors, I use it to improve the game. These new floor tiles colors should be much more pleasing to see, especially during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/b2876661db817367e3f948cfa3f2fa4373a64110.png[/img]

[b]Picking Abilities NEW UI Effect[/b]
Level up and moment of picking new ability is significant. I decided to improve this moment with a small highlight animation for each of the ability card. I hope you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a798b97bb13100fd7d79b1a37d108cb7a3bc480e.gif[/img]

[b]Improved Screen Shake[/b]
Screen shake is controversial topic - most people don't like it and feel dizzy from watching it (no worries there is option in the settings to turn it off). Still I wanted to make it properly this time, it's no longer animated, and the shake direction follows the crosshair now. This change should make the hits more impactful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/1250c564dd6a8b780dec133b3ec6a33863dc2aeb.gif[/img]

[b]Red Border Effect Indicating Player Receiving Hit[/b]
Short ghost character animation, SFX sound and hearts animation triggering on player receiving hit might not be enough to signalize this event. Now short red screen border animation will help to make that event more noticeable.

notes.title: What's coming? Major Changes in v.0.7 Steam Next Fest Demo Edition
notes.content:
Hello!

Today, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the [b]Hollow Mine v0.7 Steam Next Fest Demo Edition[/b]. 

Before we start I would like to say to everyone thank you - having a game on [b]Steam Next Fest [/b]and preparing it to release was always my dream. It wouldn't be possible without your support people! Thank you all for help by playing, reporting bugs, giving feedback and ideas! Also game evolved like that, because of all this contributions from you. Let's keep it like that! 

Join Discord or Steam Community to share your experiences with others about Hollow Mine. You are all welcome to join :-)

[h2]Upcoming Features and Changes:[/h2]

[b]Fire Mage Character[/b]
Master of the blazing arts, channeling mystical flames to incinerate foes with relentless fire and fury. Character will have increased ability to ignite enemies and damage from burning effect. Also the new Spell Rain of Fire with dealing AOE damage and instantly igniting surrounding enemies will be inside the starting equipment.

To unlock the Fire Mage, blow up 50x enemies using bomb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/dbd45ddca4bb3296ef71a9891bb6adde7e23247e.gif[/img]

[b]Spell Rain of Fire[/b]
It's another spell with AOE effect next to Ice Nova Spell. Get close to enemies cast a spell and watch how they receive damage and ignite instantly. Having increase burning damage should work well in combination with this spell. The spell will be available in initial Fire Mage equipment and in Sage's shop, you can find this NPC in mine encampment room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/572a71411853b20ecbbc834b0635d297c397efb6.gif[/img]

[b]Knight Character[/b]
A heavily armored warrior, expert in close combat, brawling, and deflecting hits. His resilience and mastery of defense make him an unstoppable force on the battlefield.

To unlock the Knight defeat mine biome boss once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a254377795eaa3fa75e4519592f76fc515eadc84.gif[/img]

[b]Menu Music Loop[/b]
New Menu music loop won't stop, there is a new ambient sound that will play after every main menu theme loop. It should make atmosphere a little bit more enjoyable while waiting to play the game in main menu.

[b]Activate Altar Room Music[/b]
While being in the room new music will play increasing the seriousness of the place and significance of the decision player is going to make to activate the artifact - Weles Burden Ring, or not.

[b]SFX Sounds[/b]
There will be more variety of SFX sounds available for players to hear during gameplay. Sounds for critical damage, almost breaking weapon or rolling items from the box and more.

[b]Angry Bee Enemy[/b]
This enemy will have a way easier style of attack - it fires 4 red bullets instantly in one direction each. It's much more easier enemy, all to make it more fair at the beginning of the game. This enemy can be found in Forest Biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/c69d8f2bc43f6b2892246d9ea1646ecf52b00808.gif[/img]

[b]Forest Camp Starting Area[/b]
Starting area with waypoint, merchant NPC and Kettle Crafting Table for potions was added. It will serve as a initial point to inform a player a bit about the lore and also it will allow new players to onboard into the game more easily. 

* - Using waypoint player can teleport back to this area. Another waypoint is inside mine encampment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/3f619af212c6ff4fd40566d8c87c9e19547d6318.png[/img]

[b]Merchant NPC[/b]
In order to help with onboarding new Merchant NPC was added to new starting Forest Camp - with items like (cheaper) health potion, bombs, basic blueprints. healthy herb and teleport scroll . Players will be able to use starting coins to buy & decide what suits them the best. 

* - Teleport scroll allows to create a portal and come back to waypoint and back to the room once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/0ec1d6fb7c86c96e14b4935432372b6b4c134229.gif[/img]

That’s it! You can also expect a bunch of other cool improvements and fixes. The complete changelog will be also available soon. See you on the release at 24th of February - the beginning of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] I hope you are excited!!

Cheers!

[b]Forest and Mine Biome New Decorations[/b]
Stones in forest biome and bones in mine biome were added around the room's unreachable area. Improving the visuals is a major factor and still is very important at this stage of development and it will be continued when ever there will be opportunity to do so. I hope you will like this new looks.

[list]
[*] Ice Arrows - Bow fires arrow projectiles with +20% increased chance to cause freeze effect
[*] Reapers Ricochete - When an enemy dies, nearby foes receive damage
[*] Deaths Echo - When an enemy dies, your next hit deals double damage
[*] Demobilize Enemy - Poisoned or frozen enemies receive +200% increased damage
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/0bf4ec4045d09e4515b3b3e0f1b9c7453cc6ce22.gif[/img]

[b]New Dracula Boss[/b]
Boss was included in Mine Biome Bosses pool. It makes it as another demo end boss next to Boruta Royal Devil. Different play style - mostly range and casting spells attacks should bring more variety and give new challenge for a players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/e69ff74045c30817a6e25f0ace7679330527e336.gif[/img]

[b]Common Unique Abilities[/b]
There are more and more abilities in the game - 30 unique abilities in total! Finding a special combo that aligns with character style is very rare. To prevent that, characters will have higher chance to get abilities that suits them.

[b]New standard Abilities[/b]
[list]
[*] Infernal surge - Increases burning damage (25%/50%/100%) 
[*] Venom taste - Increases chance (10%/20%/30%) to poison the enemy on hit
[/list]

[b]Major rebalancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Every weapon damage was adjusted to new average
[*] Standard abilities values were increased
[*] Overpowered abilities like triple shot, double cast will get reduced damage
[*] Mine Biome Bosses health was increased
[*] Enemy alert range was increased in combat and survival rooms
[*] Bosses and enemy attacks are faster with more transparent animations
[*] Some enemies can poison or freeze hero now
[/list]

[b]Burning, poison and freeze unit state effects[/b]
Now enemies and hero once affected by fire, poison or freezing effects will glow in matching color. This should better visualize the current state of the units and bring more cool visuals into the game. (Look above in casting ice nova spell gif how enemies glow light blue)

[b]Enemy short attack red glow[/b]
Enemies will have a short red glow during attacks. Thanks to that it will be more transparent when and how damage was received and help to avoid it more easily especially with melee enemies.

[b]New and improved inventory stacking features[/b]
Dragging stackable items on top of each other now adds up the stack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/567ba8982f57c7c43487b91ad67a660b2ff4ae5c.gif[/img]

Ability to see all the details on ending screen will summarize your runs in more detail. Now you will be able to even share screen shots to other people in our discord community special channel "#score-share" just use in game button to get there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/a12d2f22b18824b13aeea376a98194921e5417ff.png[/img]

Now it will be possible to see all the abilities picked in Player Statistics Panel, it will be really helpful during picking abilities to have a glance on what we already have to make better decisions in creating builds for our heros.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/44ccf1a36dfb8f6c38d09b3f99599a82c118d2df.png[/img]

Cheers!

Today, I’m excited to share what’s coming in the Hollow Mine v0.5 demo. I’m thrilled that our small community is growing thank you for being here and helping to test the early demos of Hollow Mine. notes.title: Boruta Boss - Bestiary #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44664017/4dbbd4a53819d200d6601538c1ba63c1b23abfec.gif[/img]

[b]Boruta[/b] - According to legends it was a devil depicted as nobleman from XIV century living in a Leczyca Castle Poland.

In [b]Hollow Mine[/b] he was summoned by evil forces as one of the bosses that could be found in [b]Mine biome[/b].

[b]Boruta[/b] is known for his quick sabre melee attacks up close - It's better to avoid close confrontations with him. He has ability to create pentagram portals that can summon plenty [b]Black Goblins[/b] with ability to steal your gold and to surprise you with wave of red ball projectiles on death - it would be wise to focus on these goblins first to not get overwhelmed. Besides Boruta can fire circle of red ball projectiles of his own, the way of casting that spell looks similar to creating pentagram portal.

Fighting him could be a challenge, but to make the fight more in your favor do following preparations: 
[list]
[*] Craft range based weapons like bows and using it with triple shot ability should be enough.
[*] To further increase your chances collect specific herbs and create dexterity potions to boost your damage and attack speed with range weapons. 
[*] Using spells should also work, remember to use power potions to boost spell damage instead.
[/list]

Alternatively when fighting him up close with melee weapons, bring with you ice ball spell to freeze the Boruta and immobilise him, that should give you an opening to strike up close with your sword or axe. 

For any scenario remember having additional health potion would be helpful. 

If you keep struggling you can also consider using spawning tower scroll to create a structure that will help you in battle or throw some bombs at him to get some quick advantage.
